A convolutional input adapter, low-rank backbone updates, and dedicated output decoders learn from temporally paired, geometrically registered observations, with Spatial Possibilistic Clustering Algorithm (SPOCA) catalog polygons providing CH supervision. On observations held out from downstream fine-tuning, the selected dedicated models achieve disk-restricted correlation coefficients (CCs) of 0.8196, 0.8885, and 0.8398 for the three AIA channels, respectively; the CH model achieves an intersection over union (IoU) of 0.4360. The predictions recover broad solar structure, although local agreement varies substantially by channel. An optional residual refiner addresses spatial detail, and its application on pre-SDO dates improves the correlation of synthetic AIA 304 with Solar and Heliospheric Observatory/Extreme-ultraviolet Imaging Telescope (SOHO/EIT) 304 references from 0.6511 to 0.7085. Together, these results support the feasibility of helium-conditioned EUV morphological proxies and motivate their use in historical reconstruction, within the scope of the downstream test and cross-instrument evaluation.

AI.tldr: 该文将Surya太阳基础模型适配，用全日面He I 10830 Å观测预测SDO/AIA 94、193、304 Å图像及冕洞概率图，实现历史EUV形态代理重建。
AI.motivation: 现代EUV成像之前的太阳形态缺乏直接观测记录，而He I 10830 Å具有长期观测历史，可作为推断早期EUV形态的代用数据。
AI.method: 将Surya太阳基础模型迁移至该任务：设计卷积输入适配器、低秩骨干网络更新与专用输出解码器；训练数据为时间配对且几何配准的观测，冕洞监督来自SPOCA目录多边形；并可选加入残差细化器提升空间细节。
AI.result: 在下游微调留出观测上，专用模型三通道（94、193、304 Å）盘面限制相关系数分别为0.8196、0.8885、0.8398，冕洞模型IoU为0.4360；预测能恢复整体太阳结构但局地一致性随通道差异明显。残差细化器使SDO前日期合成AIA 304与SOHO/EIT 304参考的相关性由0.6511提升至0.7085。
AI.conclusion: 结果证明了氦观测条件化EUV形态代理的可行性，支持其在历史重建中的应用，但结论限定于下游测试与跨仪器评估范围内。

title: EagleDepth: Efficient Fine-Grained Depth Estimation via Pixel Diffusion Decoder
summary: Recovering detailed geometry from high-resolution images is critical for precise perception of the surroundings and objects. However, existing methods which use latent-space modeling and VAE reconstruction can compromise geometric details. Furthermore, decoding from latent codes introduces substantial inference overhead. To address those issues, we present EagleDepth, an efficient framework for high-resolution monocular depth estimation that combines the geometric priors of latent diffusion with fine-grained pixel-space generation. Our key idea is to retain depth-aware latent representations as guidance while generating the final depth map directly in pixel space. We train the latent and pixel components sequentially: first, we fine-tune a pretrained latent diffusion model using paired RGB--depth supervision; then, we adapt a pretrained pixel diffusion decoder, PiD, to predict depth conditioned on the learned features. Training of the pixel component starts at 1024 resolution and continues across multiple resolutions up to 4K. The latent branch processes resized, lower-resolution RGB images, while the pixel branch generates depth at the target resolution, bypassing the original VAE decoder. This design preserves learned geometric knowledge without requiring the latent backbone to operate at the output resolution. On five commonly used depth estimation datasets and the high-resolution Synth4K dataset, our framework achieves state-of-the-art depth estimation performance, with faster inference and better preservation of fine structures and object boundaries.

AI.tldr: EagleDepth 提出一种高分辨率单目深度估计框架，将潜扩散模型的几何先验与像素空间细粒度生成相结合，实现 SOTA 性能并提升推理效率。
AI.motivation: 现有基于潜空间建模和 VAE 重建的方法在恢复高分辨率图像精细几何细节时会损失细节，且从潜码解码带来显著推理开销。亟需一种既能保留几何先验又能高效生成高精度深度图的方法。
AI.method: 核心思想是保留深度感知的潜表示作为引导，同时直接在像素空间生成最终深度图。采用顺序训练：先利用成对 RGB--深度监督微调预训练潜扩散模型；再适配预训练像素扩散解码器 PiD，在学到的特征条件下预测深度。像素组件训练从 1024 分辨率开始并延续至 4K 多分辨率。潜分支处理缩放后的低分辨率 RGB 图像，像素分支在目标分辨率生成深度，绕过原始 VAE 解码器。
AI.result: 在五个常用深度估计数据集及高分辨率 Synth4K 数据集上，该方法取得最先进的深度估计性能，推理更快，并更好地保留精细结构与物体边界。
AI.conclusion: EagleDepth 通过潜扩散几何先验与像素空间生成相结合，在不要求潜骨干在输出分辨率运行的情况下保留几何知识，实现高分辨率深度估计的性能与效率双赢。

title: From Probe Scores to Alarm Policies: Operational Validity of Activation Monitors for Language-Model Agents
comment: 12 pages, 1 figure. Accepted at the Eighth International Conference on Distributed Artificial Intelligence (DAI 2026)
summary: Activation probes can predict safety-relevant properties of language models with high area under the receiver-operating-characteristic curve (AUROC), but deployed agent monitors make thresholded alarm decisions under tight false-alarm budgets. These are different estimands. We introduce an Operational Validity Contract that fixes a monitor's target, observability, identity, timing, intervention unit, comparator, calibration, and cost. We formalize risk at the semantic request or trajectory level: when one task contains repeated alarm opportunities, row-level AUROC and false positive rate do not identify semantic-unit any-alarm risk. A confidence-certified threshold also requires enough independent negative units, a tie-safe rule, and transport to deployment. Across Models Under Pressure, LASR refusal prediction, immutable AgentDojo, and a prospectively protocol-frozen ST-WebAgentBench replication, joint activation-observable monitors reach AUROC 0.957 and 0.935 on the first two benchmarks, yet their locked 5%/10% detection rates are only .642/.742 and .719/.782, respectively. On AgentDojo, the secondary mean-activation rollout monitor reaches AUROC 0.922 but detects none of 38 positive semantic cases at the locked 5% operating point; thresholds intended for 10% false alarms realize 18.7-20.0% on test. Because the test misses its prospectively frozen 40-positive support gate, we label it support-insufficient. On ST-WebAgentBench, activation reaches AUROC .874, but 23 independent calibration negatives cannot identify even a 10% controller; the locked policy abstains rather than reporting its mechanical zero FPR as a success. An exploratory counterexample also lowers full AUROC while improving realized 10% utility. The fail-closed compiler caps MUP and LASR at restricted predictive value and AgentDojo and ST-Web at representation accessibility; no setting reaches alarm-policy validity.

AI.tldr: 论文指出激活探针的高AUROC不等于可部署监控有效性，提出"操作有效性契约"框架并跨四个基准测试验证，发现无任何设置达到告警策略有效性。
AI.motivation: 现有激活探针虽在AUROC上表现优异，但部署型智能体监控需在严格误报预算下做出阈值化告警决策，二者估计量不同；高AUROC不能保证低频误报下的有效检测，存在度量与部署目标错配。
AI.method: 提出操作有效性契约（Operational Validity Contract），固定监控目标、可观测性、身份、时机、干预单元、对照、校准与成本；在语义请求/轨迹层面形式化风险，指出行级AUROC与假正率无法识别语义单元任一次告警风险；要求置信认证阈值需具备足够独立负样本单元、安全处理平局的规则及部署迁移。在Models Under Pressure、LASR拒绝预测、AgentDojo和协议预冻结的ST-WebAgentBench上联合激活-可观测监控进行验证。
AI.result: 前两基准AUROC达0.957与0.935，但锁定5%/10%检测率仅.642/.742与.719/.782；AgentDojo的均值激活rollout监控AUROC 0.922，但在锁定5%操作点未检出38个正语义案例中的任何一例，目标10%误报的阈值在测试集实际达18.7-20.0%，因未达预冻结40正样本支持门槛被标为支持不足；ST-WebAgentBench激活AUROC .874，但23个独立校准负样本无法识别10%控制器，锁定策略选择弃权而非将机械零FPR报告为成功；探索性反例降低全AUROC却提升实际10%效用。
AI.conclusion: fail-closed编译器将MUP与LASR限制为预测价值受限，AgentDojo与ST-Web限制为表征可及性；没有任何设置达到告警策略有效性，说明AUROC无法替代操作有效性验证。

title: Strong Helps Weak: Directional Cross-Modal Alignment Transfer in Multi-modal LLMs
summary: Multi-modal large language models (MLLMs) achieve strong modality understanding by pairing a large language model (LLM) with an encoder for a target modality such as vision, video, or audio. However, improving an MLLM's capability for a given modality typically requires additional training on large modality-specific datasets, incurring substantial data collection and compute costs. Model merging offers an alternative, but it is often infeasible for data-scarce, large per-sample size, or domain-specific modalities (\textit{e.g.}, audio and video), where same-modality model variants are rarely available. In this work, we characterize an intriguing asymmetric phenomenon: merging a well-aligned, data-rich source-modality MLLM into a data-scarce target-modality MLLM substantially improves the target on its own benchmarks. Our theoretical and empirical analyses show that this gain stems from enhanced alignment between modality-specific and textual tokens, induced by the stronger donor modality. Specifically, we derive a mutual-information lower bound that is monotonic in alignment-related quantities and strongly correlated with downstream MLLM performance. Building on this principle, we propose Directional Cross-modal Alignment Transfer (DCAT), a novel framework that transfers textual alignment from a strong, well-aligned source (donor) modality to a weak target (recipient) modality, boosting target-modality performance without further fine-tuning. We further show that the alignment-enhancing objective admits a closed-form weight-space solution computed from only a small calibration set. DCAT outperforms existing model-merging methods, offering an efficient path toward cross-modal alignment transfer. Project page with code is available at \url{https://seohoiki3215.github.io/DCAT_project_page}

AI.tldr: 本文揭示了多模态大模型中"强源模态并入弱目标模态可提升目标模态性能"的非对称现象，并提出DCAT框架，实现无需微调的跨模态对齐迁移。
AI.motivation: 提升MLLM某模态能力通常需大量模态专属数据训练，成本高昂；而模型合并对音频、视频等数据稀缺或领域特定模态不可行，因缺少同模态模型变体。
AI.method: 作者刻画了非对称合并现象，理论与实证表明增益源于强捐体模态增强的模态token与文本token对齐；推导了与对齐量单调且与下游性能强相关的互信息下界；据此提出DCAT框架，从强对齐源模态向弱目标模态迁移文本对齐，并给出仅需小校准集的闭式权重空间解。
AI.result: DCAT在目标模态基准上无需进一步微调即可提升性能，并优于现有模型合并方法，提供了高效的跨模态对齐迁移路径。
AI.conclusion: 跨模态对齐可定向迁移，闭式权重解使数据稀缺模态的MLLM能力提升变得高效可行。

title: Frozen in a Frame: The Velocity Blind Spot in JEPA World Models
comment: 32 pages, 17 figures, 12 tables. Code, model checkpoints, and project page are available via links in the paper
summary: Joint-embedding predictive architectures (JEPAs) for world modeling train an encoder so a predictor maps a current embedding and action to the next frame's embedding, always from a single rendered frame. This has a structural blind spot: a renderer without motion blur draws a scene from configuration alone, so a single-frame embedding carries no velocity information, for any encoder, including the official released LeWM weights. We confirm this on official checkpoints across four real benchmarks (PushT, Reacher, Cube, TwoRoom): every linear velocity probe sits at or below chance while position probes reach R^2 about 0.95. We introduce RateIdent, a three-stage diagnostic protocol, and TI-JEPA, a lightweight fix splitting the latent into a pose code and an explicit finite-difference motion code, predicted jointly. Across three physically grounded environments, TI-JEPA gives a significant, seed-robust gain on a stop-at-goal planning task over a matched-memory baseline, e.g. 55% lower final distance on Pendulum (p=3.2x10^-10) and 64% on CartPole (p=5.1x10^-15). We reproduce this at official ViT-Tiny plus AdaLN-transformer scale, then push the same recipe onto real dm_control Reacher photographs trained from scratch, where TI-JEPA's branch separation exceeds the memory-having baseline's by roughly 38x, the paper's largest margin. Against a same-footprint recurrent RSSM-style predictor, TI-JEPA matches or beats its rollout accuracy on two of three environments, stays separately probeable for pose and motion, and wins outright on the most coupled one. A checkable formal argument and six evaluated environments show single-frame targets are the wrong object to predict when velocity matters, and a small, interpretable structural change fixes it with no privileged supervision. Code, checkpoints, and the project page are linked below the title.

AI.tldr: 单帧渲染的目标帧不含速度信息，导致JEPA类世界模型的潜变量无法编码速度；本文提出诊断协议RateIdent与轻量改进TI-JEPA，将潜变量分解为位姿码与显式有限差分运动码联合预测，在多个环境验证有效。
AI.motivation: JEPA世界模型以"当前嵌入+动作→下一帧嵌入"为训练目标，且始终基于单帧渲染帧。由于无运动模糊的渲染器仅由场景配置决定画面，单帧嵌入在结构上不携带速度信息，这对任何编码器（包括官方发布的LeWM权重）都成立。作者在四个真实基准上验证了官方checkpoint中线性速度探针仅处于或低于随机水平，而位置探针R²约0.95，表明该盲区是结构性的而非训练不足。
AI.method: 提出RateIdent三阶段诊断协议用于检测速度信息缺失；并提出TI-JEPA，将潜变量拆分为位姿码（pose code）与显式有限差分运动码（motion code），两者联合预测，不依赖额外特权监督。
AI.result: 在三个物理环境（Pendulum、CartPole等）的stop-at-goal规划任务上，TI-JEPA相比同等记忆基线取得显著且对随机种子稳健的提升，如Pendulum最终距离降低55%（p=3.2×10⁻¹⁰）、CartPole降低64%（p=5.1×10⁻¹⁵）；在官方ViT-Tiny+AdaLN-transformer规模上复现；在真实dm_control Reacher照片上从零训练，其分支分离度比带记忆基线高约38倍（论文最大差距）；与同规模循环RSSM式预测器相比，在三个环境中两个的rollout精度持平或更优，位姿与运动可分别探测，在最耦合的环境中胜出。
AI.conclusion: 当速度重要时，单帧目标是错误的预测对象；一个小的、可解释的结构性改动即可修复该问题，且无需特权监督。可检验的形式化论证与六个环境的评估共同支持这一结论。

title: StegoMemory: Agentic Memory Acts as Covert Steganographic Channel
summary: Is agentic memory robust against stealthy steganographic attacks? We carry out a large-scale red-teaming exercise to test whether agents can encode attacker-controlled strings in one session and recover them in another without triggering safety oversight. Following SHADE-Arena-style tasks, we embed malicious side tasks to encode secret strings using steganography within otherwise benign tasks and evaluate them using independent task-completion and safety oversight. We test 14,000 attack trials spanning 91 model-attack configurations, 13 models, and 7 steganographic schemes: Acrostic, Mesostic, Telestich, Word-choice, Capitalization, Position-based, and Homoglyph. 41.2% of trials successfully encode the target payload in the generated response, while 29.8% survive the memory-write step with the encoding intact. Overall, 25.4% of trials yield a recoverable payload at retrieval, and 20.1% achieve exact-match recovery, including synthetic API keys and cryptographic material never exposed to the receiver. Among the exact-match transmissions, 71.4% also pass primary task-completion scoring and are independently judged safe by the oversight model, corresponding to 14.4% of all trials in which a successful covert transmission would appear to be an ordinary, benign interaction under task-level evaluation. Our results demonstrate that agentic memory can function as a persistent cross-session covert channel. The results further show that the principal bottleneck occurs at memory persistence rather than retrieval: once a steganographic payload survives the memory-write stage, a substantial fraction remains recoverable. We therefore argue that memory integrity, information-flow control, and covert-channel detection should be explicit security requirements for agentic systems.

AI.tldr: 本文通过大规模红队测试证明，智能体记忆可被用作跨会话的隐蔽信道：在14,000次攻击试验中，25.4%能在检索阶段恢复出隐藏载荷，20.1%实现精确匹配，且其中71.4%同时通过任务完成评分与安全审查。
AI.motivation: 智能体具备持久化记忆能力，可跨会话存储与检索信息。这引发了新的安全问题：攻击者能否利用隐写术在看似正常的任务中写入受控字符串，并在后续会话中还原，同时绕过安全监督。作者希望系统性地评估智能体记忆作为持久化隐蔽信道的可行性。
AI.method: 采用SHADE-Arena风格任务，在良性任务中嵌入恶意副作用任务，要求智能体以隐写方式编码秘密字符串。构建14,000次攻击试验，覆盖91种模型-攻击配置、13个模型、7种隐写方案（藏头、中藏、藏尾、选词、大小写、位置、同形字符）。使用相互独立的任务完成评估与安全监督模型进行判定，并区分编码、记忆写入、检索、精确匹配等阶段。
AI.result: 41.2%的试验成功将目标载荷编码进生成响应；29.8%在记忆写入后仍保持编码完整；25.4%在检索时可恢复载荷；20.1%实现精确匹配恢复，包括从未暴露给接收方的合成API密钥与密码学材料。在精确匹配传输中，71.4%同时通过主任务完成评分并被监督模型判定为安全，占全部试验的14.4%，即隐蔽传输可表现为普通良性交互。
AI.conclusion: 智能体记忆可充当持久化的跨会话隐蔽信道。主要瓶颈在记忆持久化阶段而非检索阶段：一旦隐写载荷通过记忆写入，相当比例仍可被恢复。因此，记忆完整性、信息流控制与隐蔽信道检测应作为智能体系统明确的安全需求。

title: SIFT: Robust Meta-Faithfulness Verification of Chain-of-Thought Reasoning Under Distribution Shift
comment: Under review as a conference paper at ICLR 2027
summary: Chain-of-Thought (CoT) faithfulness detectors are widely used to audit reasoning models, yet a detector is itself a predictor whose verdicts are treated as stable properties. We ask whether a detector is faithful to itself under distribution shift. We formalize meta-faithfulness as an invariance principle: a valid detector must return identical verdicts on traces that differ only by transformations preserving ground-truth faithfulness. We prove three results: (i) no detector using only intervention-response profiles can separate faithful from epiphenomenal mechanisms with identical signatures; (ii) any detector relying on shift-sensitive features violates invariance at a rate independent of its in-distribution accuracy; (iii) an asymptotic certified selective-risk guarantee enables confident abstention. We operationalize the principle in FaithShift, a stress-test protocol spanning ten shift axes, and propose SIFT, a hidden-state trajectory detector trained with cross-environment invariance objectives and certified abstention. Across 14,996 traces, four domains, and eight models, three findings emerge. First, transfer collapse is real: all existing detectors show gaps $\geq 0.15$ AUROC. Second, the dominant bottleneck is sampling stochasticity, not shift: over 80% of detector instability stems from random seed variation, falsifying our preregistered prediction that shift-attributable violations exceed 0.25. Third, SIFT cuts invariance violations by 64% over the best single-seed baseline, but a four-seed ensemble of any detector narrows the margin to 0.01 (indistinguishable at matched coverage, $p=0.21$), and SIFT needs a 51% abstention rate. Cross-model transfer degrades from within-family to cross-family to open-weight-to-API, partly closed by multi-model training. We offer a framework for auditing auditors: the real barrier is detector variance, not distribution shift.

AI.tldr: 本文提出"元忠实性"（meta-faithfulness）不变性准则，用于审计CoT忠实性检测器自身在分布偏移下是否稳定，并给出三项理论结果与FaithShift压力测试协议及SIFT检测器；实验发现检测器不稳定的主因是采样随机性而非分布偏移。
AI.motivation: 现有CoT忠实性检测器被当作稳定属性使用，但其本身也是预测器。作者质疑检测器在分布偏移下是否对自己忠实，即其判定是否具有不变性，从而提出审计"审计者"的框架。
AI.method: 形式化元忠实性为不变性原理（仅因保持真值忠实性的变换而改变的轨迹应得到相同判定）；证明三条理论结果；构建跨十个偏移轴的FaithShift压力测试协议；提出基于隐藏状态轨迹、用跨环境不变性目标训练并带认证弃权的SIFT检测器；在14,996条轨迹、四个领域、八个模型上进行评估。
AI.result: (1) 迁移崩溃确实存在，所有现有检测器AUROC差距≥0.15；(2) 主要瓶颈是采样随机性而非偏移，超过80%的不稳定源于随机种子变化，推翻了预注册的假设（偏移导致违规>0.25）；(3) SIFT比最佳单种子基线减少64%不变性违规，但任意检测器的四种子集成可将差距缩小至0.01（匹配覆盖率下p=0.21不可区分），且SIFT需51%弃权率；跨模型迁移从同族到跨族到开放权重到API逐渐退化，多模型训练可部分弥补。
AI.conclusion: 提出审计审计者的框架，核心结论是检测器不稳定的真正障碍是检测器自身的方差，而非分布偏移。

title: WASP: Weakly Aligned Spatiotemporal Pairs for Fetal Brain MRI-Ultrasound Learning
comment: Accepted at NeurIPS 2026. 21 pages, 3 figures, 11 tables. Code: https://github.com/miccunifi/WASP
summary: Magnetic Resonance Imaging (MRI) is widely regarded as the optimal sensor for fetal brain analysis due to its superior soft-tissue contrast and anatomical detail. However, its high cost and operational burden make it invasive and difficult to obtain at scale. Ultrasound (US), in contrast, is cheap, safe, and routinely acquired, and as a result it has produced substantially larger datasets and a growing ecosystem of pretrained models. This asymmetry raises a natural question: Can we teach a US-only model to understand fetal MRI from only a limited set of examples? The standard recipe, training a foundation model on subject-to-subject paired MRI-US scans, is not viable since no such paired fetal dataset is publicly available. In this paper we address this gap with Weakly Aligned Spatiotemporal Pairs (WASP), a framework that formulates cross-modal correspondence as an entropic Optimal Transport problem driven by clinical metadata, in particular Gestational Age (GA) and diagnostic planes, enabling the fitting of a lightweight alignment module that lifts MRI representations into the US latent space, without fine-tuning the backbone. Empirically, WASP yields its largest gains when MRI is unseen by the model during pretraining (on USFM, GA estimation error drops from 21.9 to 17.4 days and standard plane classification accuracy climbs from 61.9% to 69.0%), while providing smaller, backbone-dependent refinements for backbones pretrained on both modalities (e.g., BioMedParse GA estimation error from 6.5 to 6.0 days and SAM-Med2d plane accuracy from 83.3% to 88.1%). Code is available at https://github.com/miccunifi/WASP.

AI.tldr: 提出WASP框架，用临床元数据驱动的熵最优传输对齐弱配对MRI-US，使US模型无需重训即可理解胎儿MRI。
AI.motivation: 胎儿MRI成像质量优但成本高、难以规模化，而超声廉价、安全、数据量大且有丰富预训练模型；但公开数据中不存在同一受试者的配对MRI-US胎儿数据集，因此无法采用常规的配对跨模态预训练方案，需要新的跨模态对应方法。
AI.method: WASP（Weakly Aligned Spatiotemporal Pairs）将跨模态对应形式化为熵最优传输（Entropic Optimal Transport）问题，由临床元数据（胎龄GA与诊断切面）驱动，训练一个轻量对齐模块，把MRI表征映射到US隐空间，且不微调骨干网络。
AI.result: 当预训练未见过MRI时收益最大：在USFM上GA估计误差由21.9降至17.4天，标准切面分类准确率由61.9%升至69.0%；对同时预训练两模态的骨干提升较小且依赖骨干，如BioMedParse的GA误差6.5→6.0天，SAM-Med2d切面准确率83.3%→88.1%。
AI.conclusion: WASP在缺乏配对胎儿MRI-US数据的情况下，实现了将MRI表征迁移到US隐空间的有效对齐，尤其对仅用US预训练的模型带来显著增益，为跨模态胎儿影像分析提供了可行方案。

title: Organize Primitives into Semantic Parts: Reinforcement Reasoning for 3D Segmentation
summary: Primitive-based 3D segmentation offers a compact and explicit alternative to dense surface prediction, naturally supporting structural abstraction and boundary localization. However, geometric decomposition alone does not determine how primitives should be organized into semantic parts: a single part may span multiple primitives, while geometrically similar or touching primitives may belong to different parts. We therefore introduce RePart (Reinforcement Part Reasoning), which formulates primitive-to-part organization as a finite-horizon Markov decision process and learns semantic organization through trajectory-level reinforcement reasoning. RePart constructs a Composable Primitive Workspace from fine-grained superquadrics and applies a merge-and-stop policy whose decisions are optimized by their downstream effects on the resulting partition rather than local primitive compatibility. The inferred part identities are then mapped back to the original mesh through Boundary-Aware Surface Labeling, preserving accurate surface boundaries beyond the primitive approximation. On PartNet, RePart achieves the strongest results across all four aggregate partition metrics; on 3DCoMPaT++, it obtains the highest RI and SC without target-dataset fine-tuning. These results demonstrate that reinforcement reasoning provides an effective mechanism for organizing geometric primitives into semantic parts while retaining dense segmentation accuracy. Code is available at https://github.com/EngineeringAI-LAB/RePart.

AI.tldr: RePart将基元到部件的组织建模为有限时域马尔可夫决策过程，通过轨迹级强化推理学习语义组织，在PartNet和3DCoMPaT++上取得优异的分割性能。
AI.motivation: 基于基元的三维分割虽紧凑且显式，但几何分解本身无法决定基元如何组织成语义部件：单个部件可跨越多个基元，几何相似或接触的基元也可能属于不同部件。
AI.method: 将基元到部件的组织形式化为有限时域马尔可夫决策过程；构建由细粒度超二次曲面组成的Composable Primitive Workspace；采用合并-停止策略，其决策由对最终分割的下游影响而非局部基元兼容性来优化；再通过Boundary-Aware Surface Labeling将推断的部件身份映射回原始网格，保留精确表面边界。
AI.result: 在PartNet上，RePart在全部四项聚合分割指标上取得最强结果；在3DCoMPaT++上，无需目标数据集微调即获得最高的RI和SC。
AI.conclusion: 强化推理为将几何基元组织为语义部件提供了有效机制，同时保持稠密分割精度。

title: ConEx: Human-Interpretable Saliency Maps via Concept-Aware Attribution
summary: Many visual explanation methods in computer vision highlight pixel importance but struggle to link these low-level cues to semantically meaningful concepts, limiting their interpretability and trustworthiness. We introduce Concept-based Explanations (ConEx), a novel framework that bridges saliency visualization with concept-based reasoning to provide both faithfulness and interpretability. ConEx automatically discovers class-specific concepts and represents them through concept activation vectors (CAVs), learned without manual supervision using an architecture-specific masking mechanism that reduces noise introduced by the segmentation masks to enhance concept purity. ConEx generates faithful saliency maps that reveal where each concept appears in the image and how it contributes to the prediction. To evaluate the reliability of these learned concepts, we propose two complementary metrics, Vector-Concept Match (VCM) and Concept-Class Match (CCM), that quantify concept alignment and enable direct comparison with existing methods. Extensive experiments across diverse settings demonstrate that ConEx achieves state-of-the-art performance on faithfulness, segmentation, and concept-quality benchmarks. Overall, ConEx advances the field toward truly interpretable and concept-grounded explanations in vision models.

AI.tldr: 本文提出ConEx框架，将显著性可视化与概念推理结合，自动发现类特定概念并以概念激活向量表示，生成忠实显著图，并提出VCM与CCM两个指标评估概念可靠性，在多基准上达到最优。
AI.motivation: 现有计算机视觉解释方法多仅高亮像素重要性，难以将低层线索与语义概念关联，限制了可解释性与可信度。
AI.method: ConEx自动发现类特定概念，用概念激活向量（CAVs）表示；通过架构特定的掩码机制在无人工监督下学习，减少分割掩码噪声以提升概念纯度；生成揭示各概念出现位置及其对预测贡献的忠实显著图；提出VCM（Vector-Concept Match）与CCM（Concept-Class Match）两个互补指标量化概念对齐。
AI.result: 在忠实性、分割与概念质量等多类基准、多种设置下，ConEx均取得最优（state-of-the-art）性能。
AI.conclusion: ConEx将视觉解释推向真正可解释、以概念为基础的方向，兼顾忠实性与可解释性。

title: Sparse-View 4D Gaussian Splatting via Spatiotemporal Priors and Generative Assistance
comment: 4 pages, 5 figures, Accepted to SIGGRAPH Asia 2026 Workshops (SA Workshops '26)
summary: We present a 4D Gaussian Splatting framework for the Sparse-View Track of the SIGGRAPH Asia 2026 Volumetric Video Challenge, which requires dynamic scene reconstruction from only six cameras with wide baselines. To achieve robust dynamic reconstruction under such sparse views, our framework integrates three components. (1) Region-adaptive spatial priors: We use foreground masks to guide Gaussian initialization and mask voting to control densification separately for the dynamic foreground and static background. Background geometry is regularized using monocular depth aligned to metric scale. (2) Motion-consistent temporal priors: We provide supervision at intermediate times through frame interpolation and constrain projected Gaussian motion with estimated optical flow. (3) Generative assistance: We place virtual cameras in the widest angular gaps and restore their rendered images using a diffusion-based model conditioned on camera poses. The restored images are iteratively incorporated into training as pseudo-supervision. On the validation set, our framework improves full-frame PSNR from 25.60 dB for the baseline to 29.75 dB. On the official test benchmark, it achieves 30.04 dB full-frame PSNR and 27.88 dB foreground PSNR, ranking first overall in the Sparse-View Track.

AI.tldr: 提出一种面向稀疏视角（仅6台宽基线相机）动态场景重建的4D高斯泼溅框架，融合区域自适应空间先验、运动一致时间先验与扩散模型生成辅助，在SIGGRAPH Asia 2026体视频挑战赛稀疏视角赛道取得第一。
AI.motivation: 该挑战赛要求仅用6台宽基线相机完成动态场景重建，极稀疏视角导致初始化不稳定、几何与运动监督严重不足，基线方法难以恢复可靠的动态结构与前景细节。
AI.method: 框架包含三部分：（1）区域自适应空间先验：用前景掩码引导高斯初始化，并以掩码投票对动态前景与静态背景分别控制稠密化，背景几何用对齐至度量尺度的单目深度进行正则化；（2）运动一致时间先验：通过帧插值在中间时刻提供监督，并用估计光流约束高斯的投影运动；（3）生成式辅助：在最大角度空隙处放置虚拟相机，用相机位姿条件化的扩散模型修复其渲染图像，并作为伪监督迭代加入训练。
AI.result: 验证集全帧PSNR由基线的25.60 dB提升至29.75 dB；官方测试基准上达30.04 dB全帧PSNR与27.88 dB前景PSNR，在稀疏视角赛道综合排名第一。
AI.conclusion: 通过耦合空间先验、时间先验与扩散生成伪监督，可显著缓解宽基线稀疏视角下的动态重建困难，验证了生成式辅助在4D高斯泼溅中的有效性，并在官方挑战赛中取得领先性能。

title: ForeAct3D: Policy-Grounded Future World Modeling for VLA Policies
summary: Robots need to anticipate how their actions will change the world, since manipulation success hinges on the resulting contacts and object motions. However, existing Vision-Language-Action (VLA) policies that predict future observations from shared features leave the forecast decoupled from the actions the policy will actually execute, and impose no physical constraints on how the scene may evolve. We introduce ForeAct3D, a framework for policy-grounded future world modeling within VLA policies. Learnable geometric queries decode depth, semantic segmentation, and camera pose from the policy representation into current and future semantic 3D scene states, and the future queries are conditioned on the policy-generated action chunk to ground the forecast in the planned interaction. A physical-consistency closure relates the two states through background staticity and instance-level rigidity, and anchors the wrist-camera pose to end-effector kinematics. These objectives shape the shared representation used for action generation during training, and no future prediction is required at inference. Without robot pretraining, ForeAct3D achieves 98.3% average success on LIBERO and an average task length of 3.73 on CALVIN, outperforming its base policy on every suite. Ablations show that semantic 3D supervision, physical consistency, and action conditioning each improve manipulation performance, and that action conditioning substantially improves future object localization. Real-world experiments on spatial placement, object insertion, and sequential manipulation further raise average success from 6.7% to 37.8% over the base policy. The project page and code are available at https://github.com/anthonytao80-crypto/ForeAct3D.

AI.tldr: ForeAct3D提出一种“策略锚定的未来世界建模”框架，在VLA策略训练中通过由动作块条件化的几何查询预测当前与未来的语义3D场景状态，并施加物理一致性约束来塑造共享表征，推理时无需未来预测，在LIBERO、CALVIN及真实任务上均显著优于基策略。
AI.motivation: 现有VLA策略从共享特征预测未来观测时，预测与策略实际执行的动作解耦，且不对场景演化施加物理约束，导致预测难以反映真实交互后果。
AI.method: 引入可学习的几何查询，从策略表征中解码深度、语义分割与相机位姿，得到当前与未来的语义3D场景状态；未来查询以策略生成的动作块为条件以锚定预测；通过背景静止性与实例级刚性的物理一致性闭环关联两状态，并将腕部相机位姿绑定到末端执行器运动学；这些目标在训练中塑造用于动作生成的共享表征，推理时无需未来预测。
AI.result: 在无机器人预训练条件下，LIBERO平均成功率98.3%，CALVIN平均任务长度3.73，每个套件均超过基策略；消融表明语义3D监督、物理一致性与动作条件化各自提升操作性能，动作条件化大幅改善未来物体定位；真实世界空间放置、物体插入与序列操作任务平均成功率由6.7%提升至37.8%。
AI.conclusion: 以策略锚定并受物理约束的未来语义3D世界建模可有效塑造VLA共享表征，在不增加推理开销的前提下提升仿真与真实操作性能，验证了动作条件化与物理一致性对表征学习的关键作用。

title: PerturBot: Breaking Shortcut Priors in Vision-Language-Action Models with Perturbative Training
summary: A vision--language--action (VLA) policy can complete complex tasks while ignoring the evidence that should determine its actions. An object held near the wrist camera can displace the instructed target. Language and action show the same pattern: a familiar noun can trigger the operation it was paired with in training even after the verb changes, and a gripper that closed on nothing may lift anyway. We call these dependencies modality shortcuts: regularities in successful demonstrations make visual, lexical, or motor cues sufficient to predict expert actions without the task evidence needed for the underlying decision. More demonstrations of the same kind can raise task success while leaving these shortcuts intact. We propose Perturbot which makes task-relevant evidence easier to use and shortcuts insufficient on their own: it applies task-preserving wrist-view perturbations, enriches instructions with decision-relevant captions, and adds random and failed trajectory segments relabeled with the behavior they contain. It complements scaling by changing what is scaled, and leaves inference unchanged. Moreover, we propose GroundingFscore, an offline score that diagnoses how severely a policy relies on modality shortcuts. Task success rate shows whether a policy improves, while GroundingFscore reveals whether the policy scales healthily, relying on task evidence rather than shortcuts. Together, Perturbot and GroundingFscore provide a training-and-evaluation framework for disentangling VLA decisions from shortcut priors while preserving responsiveness to task-relevant evidence.

AI.tldr: 论文提出 VLA 策略中的"模态捷径"概念，并设计 Perturbot 训练框架与 GroundingFscore 评估指标，以分离 VLA 决策与捷径先验。
AI.motivation: 视觉-语言-动作（VLA）策略虽能完成复杂任务，却可能忽略真正决定其动作的任务证据。例如腕部相机附近的物体可挤占被指令目标；语言与动作层面也存在类似模式——熟悉的动词改变后名词仍能触发训练中配对的操作，夹爪空夹也能抬升。作者将这种成功示范中的规律性（视觉、词汇或运动线索足以预测专家动作）称为"模态捷径"，并指出更多同类示范能提升任务成功率，却无法消除这些捷径。
AI.method: Perturbot：任务保持的腕部视角扰动；用决策相关描述丰富指令；加入随机与失败轨迹片段，并按其中实际行为重新标注。该方法在"缩放什么"上改变，而不改变缩放本身，且保持推理阶段不变。GroundingFscore：一种离线评分，诊断策略对模态捷径的依赖严重程度。
AI.result: 任务成功率反映策略是否改善，而 GroundingFscore 揭示策略是否"健康地"扩展——即依赖任务证据而非捷径。二者的具体实验结果原文未给出数值。
AI.conclusion: Perturbot 与 GroundingFscore 共同构成一套训练与评估框架，在保持对任务相关证据响应的同时，将 VLA 决策与捷径先验解耦。

title: Stance Drift: How AI-mediated Communication Distorts Our Message
summary: Large language models (LLMs) increasingly mediate human communication, from drafting emails to summarizing scientific reports, yet whether they faithfully preserve a speaker's position remains largely untested. We model AI-mediated communication as a two-step generation-extraction pipeline: one LLM produces an argument from a specified stance, and a second LLM extracts the stance from that argument. We represent the pipeline as a probabilistic state transition over five Likert-type stance categories and define the stance preservation rate (SPR) as the average probability that the extracted stance matches the initial stance. Across 112 debate propositions, none of the nine LLMs tested exceeded an SPR of 0.7 under the default configuration. Three drift patterns accounted for most of the drift: polarization, deviation from neutrality, and flipping. Among the mitigation strategies tested, including in-context learning, multiple extraction with shuffled options, assertion, and reflection, only adding medium reasoning effort to a reflection prompt for GPT-5.4 substantially improved the SPR, to 0.775, yet polarization remained the largest pattern, with 0.119 of the transition mass. An exploratory comparison with human extraction on a single proposition suggests that drift arises at both the generation and the extraction stage. These results point to a fidelity gap in AI-mediated communication, with implications for journalism, policy deliberation, scientific communication, and other domains where opinion-laden messages pass through language models.

AI.tldr: 本文将AI中介沟通建模为"生成-抽取"两步流程，提出立场保持率(SPR)指标，测试9个LLM在112个辩论命题上的立场保真度，发现无一超过0.7，漂移主要呈极化、偏离中立与翻转三种模式；仅GPT-5.4配合反思提示与中等推理力度将SPR提升至0.775，但极化仍最突出。
AI.motivation: 大语言模型已广泛介入人类沟通（撰写邮件、总结科学报告等），但其能否忠实保留说话者立场尚未被系统检验，这构成了AI中介沟通中的保真度缺口，直接影响新闻、政策审议与科学传播等场景。
AI.method: 将AI中介沟通建模为两步"生成-抽取"流水线：一个LLM按指定立场生成论证，另一个LLM从该论证中抽取立场；用五类Likert式立场类别上的概率状态转移来描述该流程，定义SPR为抽取立场与初始立场一致的平均概率。在112个辩论命题上测试9个LLM，考察默认配置下的漂移模式，并比较上下文学习、乱序选项多次抽取、断言、反思等缓解策略，另对单一命题做与人类抽取的探索性对照。
AI.result: 默认配置下，9个测试模型中无一SPR超过0.7；漂移主要归为三种模式：极化、偏离中立与翻转。各类缓解策略中，只有为GPT-5.4的反思提示加入中等推理力度才显著提升SPR至0.775，但极化仍为最大漂移模式，占0.119的转移质量。与人类抽取的探索性对照显示，漂移同时产生于生成与抽取两个阶段。
AI.conclusion: 当前LLM在立场传递上存在系统性保真度缺口，漂移兼具生成端与抽取端来源，且现有缓解手段效果有限；这一发现对新闻、政策审议、科学传播等依赖语言模型传递含观点信息的领域具有重要启示。

title: Task-Sensitive Geometry of Representation Transfer for Object Detection under Image Degradation
summary: Object detection under image degradation can benefit from clean-image supervision, but aggregate gains do not imply that transferred representation changes are uniformly useful. We study how clean task knowledge affects degraded-image representations and whether local responses to structured representation directions can be characterized geometrically. Using paired clean and Gaussian-degraded BDD100K images, we show that clean-teacher distillation improves observed detection accuracy while producing heterogeneous object-level transfer. We isolate a representation component complementary to direct clean-teacher alignment and map it into the distilled student space through an orthogonal bridge. Controlled interventions rescue 13.22% of objects lost under the distilled representation, versus 4.30% under norm-matched random perturbations, with very low harm on preserved objects. We introduce task-sensitive geometry, a gradient-derived channel-space geometry constructed from normalized detection-loss gradients. On a reserved cohort, mapped-complement orientation within this frozen geometry is positively associated with local intervention-response magnitude after controlling for intervention magnitude (partial Spearman $ρ$ = 0.242, 95% CI [0.108, 0.359]). The relationship eplicates on independent data ($ρ$ = 0.180) and with RT-DETR-L ($ρ$ = 0.227), but not for the direct clean-teacher residual family, and it weakens for large interventions. Routing rules and specialized distillation objectives based on these signals do not yield statistically reliable gains over CLEANKD. These results support a local, direction-family-dependent task-sensitive geometry while showing that converting such structure into improved global training remains an open problem.

AI.tldr: 本文研究干净图像监督如何影响退化图像的目标检测表征：干净教师蒸馏虽提升整体精度，却产生异构的物体级迁移；作者分离出一个与直接干净教师对齐互补的表征成分，经正交桥接映射到学生空间，可挽救13.22%丢失目标（随机扰动仅4.30%），并提出由检测损失梯度构建的"任务敏感几何"，发现其在保留队列上对干预响应有正向局部关联（偏Spearman ρ=0.242），但将此类结构转化为全局训练增益仍是开放问题。
AI.motivation: 干净图像监督在退化图像目标检测中总体有效，但"聚合增益"掩盖了表征变化的非均匀性：并非所有迁移的表征成分都对退化图像有益。作者希望厘清两个问题：(1)干净任务知识在物体级别如何改变退化图像表征；(2)能否对结构化表征方向上的局部响应进行几何刻画，从而为表征诊断提供可解释工具。
AI.method: 使用BDD100K的成对干净/高斯退化图像，以干净教师蒸馏训练学生模型并观察物体级迁移的异质性。分离出与直接干净教师对齐互补的表征成分，通过正交桥接(orthogonal bridge)映射到蒸馏学生空间，并进行受控干预实验（与范数匹配的随机扰动对照）。提出"任务敏感几何"(task-sensitive geometry)：由归一化检测损失梯度导出的通道空间几何，在保留队列上检验映射互补方向取向与局部干预响应幅度的关联，并做消融/复制实验（独立数据、RT-DETR-L）、控制干预幅度、检验直接干净教师残差族与大干预情形，同时评估基于该信号的路径规则与专门蒸馏目标。
AI.result: 干净教师蒸馏提升观测检测精度但物体级迁移异构。正交桥接映射的互补成分干预可挽救13.22%在蒸馏表征下丢失的目标，随机范数匹配扰动仅4.30%，且对已保留目标伤害极低。在保留队列上，任务敏感几何中映射互补方向取向与局部干预响应幅度正相关（偏Spearman ρ=0.242, 95% CI [0.108, 0.359]）；该关系在独立数据复现（ρ=0.180），在RT-DETR-L上复现（ρ=0.227），但在直接干净教师残差族上不成立，且随干预幅度增大而减弱。基于这些信号的路由规则与专门蒸馏目标相对CLEANKD未取得统计可靠增益。
AI.conclusion: 结果支持一种局部的、依赖方向族的任务敏感几何：局部表征响应可被损失梯度导出的几何所刻画，且该结构具有方向族特异性。然而，将这种局部结构信号转化为可靠的全局训练增益仍是未解决的开放问题，说明"可诊断"不等于"可优化"。

title: DistScene: Object-to-Scene Distillation for 3D Scene Generation
summary: We present DistScene, a framework for single-image compositional 3D scene generation by jointly modeling the environment and individual objects. Unlike existing methods that represent scenes primarily as collections of objects, we model the environment as an explicit scene component to provide geometric context for object placement. Specifically, we introduce Scene-Frame Generation, which jointly generates separate environment and object components in a shared coordinate frame, allowing their geometry and relative placement to be learned together. Then we introduce Object-Centric Refinement to refine each object in a local frame with scene context. Finally, we develop Object-to-Scene Distillation to transfer pretrained object-generation priors to scene generation through automatically composed and rendered synthetic scenes. Evaluations on indoor and outdoor benchmarks demonstrate improved scene-level spatial coherence over the evaluated baselines. Project page: https://coolbeam.github.io/DistScene/

AI.tldr: DistScene是一个单图像组合式3D场景生成框架，通过对环境与个体对象联合建模，提升场景级空间一致性。
AI.motivation: 现有方法主要将场景表示为对象的集合，忽略了环境作为显式场景组件所提供的几何上下文，从而影响对象放置的合理性。
AI.method: 提出三个核心组件：Scene-Frame Generation在共享坐标框架下联合生成环境与对象组件，使几何与相对布局可共同学习；Object-Centric Refinement在局部框架中结合场景上下文对每个对象进行细化；Object-to-Scene Distillation通过自动合成并渲染的合成场景，将预训练的对象生成先验迁移到场景生成中。
AI.result: 在室内与室外基准测试上，相较所比较的基线方法，展现出更优的场景级空间一致性。
AI.conclusion: 将环境建模为显式场景组件并结合蒸馏对象先验，可有效改善单图像组合式3D场景生成的空间一致性。

title: Does Neural Complexity Improve Health Misinformation Detection? A Leakage-Controlled Cross-Corpus Benchmark
comment: 18 pages, 3 tables. Reproducibility materials and source code are available from the author
summary: Increasing architectural complexity is often assumed to improve health misinformation detection, yet reported gains are difficult to interpret when studies use different corpora, preprocessing pipelines, data splits, and leakage controls. This study provides a controlled cross-corpus benchmark of five compact neural architectures (1D-CNN, LSTM, BiLSTM, CNN-LSTM, and CNN-BiLSTM), a soft-voting neural ensemble, and three classical machine-learning baselines using COVID19-FNIR and CONSTRAINT. Exact-text duplicate controls were applied before modelling; all neural systems used a common preprocessing and optimisation protocol, and neural results were repeated across three random seeds. On COVID19-FNIR, the deep ensemble achieved a mean macro-F1 of 0.9963 and ROC-AUC of 0.9994, while individual neural models ranged from 0.9945 to 0.9957 macro-F1. On CONSTRAINT, the ensemble achieved macro-F1 of 0.9272 and ROC-AUC of 0.9811, whereas a linear SVM achieved macro-F1 of 0.9574 and ROC-AUC of 0.9931. Architecture rankings changed across corpora, and simple sparse linear models remained highly competitive. The findings show that model complexity does not provide a stable performance advantage and that benchmark construction can dominate architecture choice. The study contributes a reproducible, leakage-controlled basis for evidence-driven model selection in health misinformation classification

AI.tldr: 该研究通过控制变量、跨语料库的基准测试，发现更复杂的神经网络架构并不总是比简单线性模型（如SVM）提供稳定的健康虚假信息检测性能优势，基准构建本身可能主导架构选择的效果。
AI.motivation: 当前常假设增加架构复杂度能提升健康虚假信息检测效果，但由于已有研究在语料库、预处理流程、数据划分和泄漏控制方面各不相同，报告的增益难以解读。因此需要一项受控的跨语料库基准来公平比较不同复杂度模型的实际表现。
AI.method: 在COVID19-FNIR和CONSTRAINT两个语料库上，对五种紧凑神经网络架构（1D-CNN、LSTM、BiLSTM、CNN-LSTM、CNN-BiLSTM）、一种软投票神经集成模型及三种经典机器学习基线进行受控基准测试。建模前应用精确文本重复控制，所有神经网络采用统一的预处理和优化协议，并在三个随机种子上重复实验。
AI.result: 在COVID19-FNIR上，深度集成模型达到平均macro-F1为0.9963、ROC-AUC为0.9994，单个神经模型macro-F1为0.9945~0.9957；在CONSTRAINT上，集成模型macro-F1为0.9272、ROC-AUC为0.9811，而线性SVM达到macro-F1为0.9574、ROC-AUC为0.9931。架构排名在不同语料库间发生变化，简单稀疏线性模型保持高度竞争力。
AI.conclusion: 模型复杂度不能提供稳定的性能优势，基准构建可能主导架构选择。该研究为健康虚假信息分类中证据驱动的模型选择提供了可复现、控制泄漏的基础。

title: Grounding Probes: Generator-Independent Hallucination Detection from Observer Model Hidden States
comment: 13 pages, 4 figures, 4 tables. Code and per-sample predictions: https://github.com/MRathmayr/LettuceDetect
summary: Detecting responses that retrieval-augmented generation does not ground in its context trades speed against accuracy: surface checks miss paraphrased fabrication, sampling-based methods cost extra generations. Hidden-state probes sit between the two, but every existing one reads the generating model's own activations, so a change of generator invalidates the detector and a closed-weight generator is out of reach. This paper removes that coupling. The Grounding Probe is logistic regression over the mean-pooled middle-layer hidden states of an observer language model that reads the context, question, and response in one forward pass and generates nothing, with the recipe it needs: pool over response tokens, read a middle layer, and control capacity, which closes the train-test AUROC gap from 0.087-0.202 to 0.009-0.013. Asking the observer outright, rather than reading its hidden state, costs at least +0.166 AUROC in every one of four models. Fitted on 15,090 annotated responses it reaches 0.879-0.894 AUROC on RAGTruth test across four observers, and 0.924 AUROC with 0.820 F1@0.5 averaged with a supervised span detector, 0.060 above that detector alone. One probe holds across six generators, and hold-out controls, including one in which no evaluation prompt appears in training, bound the cost of removing a generator at about 0.02 AUROC. Code, probes, and predictions are released.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出 Grounding Probe，用独立观察者语言模型的中间层隐藏状态做逻辑回归，检测 RAG 中未基于上下文的幻觉响应，无需访问生成模型激活，跨生成器可迁移。
AI.motivation: 现有检测 RAG 非基于上下文响应的方法存在速度与精度权衡：表层检查漏检改写型捏造，采样方法需额外生成；而现有隐藏状态探针依赖生成模型自身激活，更换生成器即失效，闭权重生成器无法使用。
AI.method: Grounding Probe 对观察者语言模型中间层隐藏状态做均值池化的逻辑回归；观察者一次性读入上下文、问题和响应，不生成内容。关键配方：池化响应 token、读取中间层、控制容量。
AI.result: 容量控制将训练-测试 AUROC 差距从 0.087-0.202 缩小到 0.009-0.013；直接询问观察者比读隐藏状态在四个模型上均低至少 +0.166 AUROC。在 15,090 条标注响应上拟合，四个观察者在 RAGTruth 测试集达 0.879-0.894 AUROC；与监督跨度检测器平均达 0.924 AUROC、0.820 F1@0.5，比单用检测器高 0.060。一个探针跨六个生成器保持有效，去掉生成器的代价约 0.02 AUROC。
AI.conclusion: 该方法将检测器与生成器解耦，跨生成器可迁移，精度接近采样方法且速度快，适用于闭权重生成器；代码、探针和预测均已公开。

title: Verdicts Without Annotated Evidence: Rejection Sampling or Label-Only Post-Training for Evidence Recovery?
summary: In many review workflows the verdict is the only thing retained. The passages behind it are not marked, because that annotation costs far more than recording the decision. We measure how much of that evidence a small language model can recover when it is post-trained on the verdicts alone, with no human evidence labels at any stage. On ContractNLI the human evidence spans are held out until evaluation. Matching the recorded verdict and agreeing with those spans are not the same thing: across six systems the two scores are only weakly related and rank the systems differently, so accuracy is a poor guide when the citations have to be reviewable. Label-only training on the bare verdict reaches accuracy 0.896 and span F1 0.564. Rejection sampling, which keeps a generated trace only when its verdict matches the record and then picks one by an automatic source-grounding score, reaches 0.797 and 0.556, against 0.747 and 0.493 before training. Verbatim citation rises from 0.597 to 0.729 under label-only training and to 0.701 under rejection sampling. One seed on one corpus cannot say which method is better, but both improve the evidence without anyone annotating it.

AI.tldr: 研究在仅有判决标签、无任何人工证据标注的条件下，小型语言模型能恢复多少支撑判决的原文证据。在ContractNLI上将人工证据跨度留作评测，发现判决准确率与证据跨度一致度仅弱相关且排序不同。仅标签训练达准确率0.896、跨度F1 0.564；拒绝采样达0.797与0.556（未训练前为0.747与0.493）。逐字引用率由0.597升至0.729（仅标签训练）和0.701（拒绝采样）。单语料单种子不足以判定优劣，但两种方法均无需人工标注即可改善证据质量。
AI.motivation: 在评审工作流中通常只保留判决结论，其背后的原文证据段落因标注成本远高于记录决策而未被标注。论文旨在衡量在完全没有人工证据标签的情况下，仅以后训练方式使用判决结果的小型语言模型能恢复多少证据，并论证为何不能仅以判决准确率作为评价依据——因为匹配判决与匹配证据跨度并不等价。
AI.method: 在ContractNLI数据集上进行实验，将人工证据跨度保留至评测阶段，训练过程中不接触任何人工证据标签。对比两种方法：一是仅标签训练（label-only training），直接以裸判决为监督信号；二是拒绝采样（rejection sampling），仅保留判决与记录一致且通过自动来源接地评分筛选的生成轨迹。共评测六个系统，比较判决准确率、证据跨度F1与逐字引用率。
AI.result: 仅标签训练达到准确率0.896、跨度F1 0.564；拒绝采样达到0.797与0.556，而未训练基线为0.747与0.493。逐字引用率从0.597升至0.729（仅标签训练）与0.701（拒绝采样）。六个系统间判决准确率与证据跨度一致度仅弱相关，且对系统排序不同。
AI.conclusion: 判决准确率在需要可复核引用时是较差的指导指标，因为匹配判决与匹配证据跨度并不等价。单一种子、单一语料不足以断言哪种方法更优，但仅标签训练与拒绝采样均能在无人标注证据的情况下改善证据质量，说明判决本身可作为恢复证据的有效弱监督信号。

title: WavePrune: One period is often enough for RoPE
summary: Rotary Position Embedding (RoPE) encodes token positions by rotating each two-dimensional channel of the query and key vectors at a channel-specific frequency, making the attention logits invariant to a common shift of positions. However, this rotation is periodic, and it leads to position aliasing where relative positions separated by a full rotation period become hard to tell apart. To address this, we propose WavePrune, which restricts each channel to its first rotation period. We show that it removes the distractions in attention maps created by position aliasing and improves overall long-context performance. Specifically, WavePrune raises the HELMET score on four of five models we test without any extra tuning (e.g., 35.7 -> 40.0 on Qwen3-8B). When pretraining models from scratch, WavePrune also achieves lower validation loss at extrapolated lengths than pretraining without it. Because WavePrune restricts each channel to a sliding window, it induces a fine-grained sparsity that our hardware-aligned CUDA kernels exploit for 1.15x prefill and 1.24x decoding speedups over FlashAttention-2 at 32K context. Together, these results show that RoPE's periodic structure, widely regarded as essential, is largely redundant beyond the first rotation period.

AI.tldr: 提出 WavePrune，将每个 RoPE 通道限制在首个旋转周期内，消除位置混叠，改善长上下文性能，并通过硬件对齐的 CUDA 内核获得加速。
AI.motivation: RoPE 通过按通道频率旋转 query/key 的二维通道来编码位置，使注意力 logits 对位置的整体平移保持不变。但该旋转具有周期性，导致相隔一个完整旋转周期的相对位置难以区分，即出现位置混叠（position aliasing），会给注意力图带来干扰，损害长上下文性能。
AI.method: 提出 WavePrune，将每个通道限制在其第一个旋转周期内。由于该限制等价于为每个通道施加一个滑动窗口，从而诱导出细粒度稀疏性，作者设计硬件对齐的 CUDA 内核来利用这一稀疏性。
AI.result: 在测试的五种模型中的四种上，无需额外调优即提升 HELMET 分数（如 Qwen3-8B 从 35.7 提升至 40.0）。从头预训练时，WavePrune 在外推长度上取得更低的验证损失。在 32K 上下文下，相较 FlashAttention-2 实现 1.15 倍 prefill 和 1.24 倍 decoding 加速。
AI.conclusion: 结果表明，RoPE 被广泛视为关键的周期性结构，在第一个旋转周期之外很大程度上是冗余的。

title: FLASHSWIN: Unlocking Large Windows and Dense Tokens in Swin Vision Transformers with Memory Efficient Attention
summary: High-resolution vision backbones have long been forced to trade away local token density to afford larger receptive fields. Hierarchical Swin transformers impose this compromise because standard windowed attention materializes an $M^2\times M^2$ score matrix per window, incurring $O(M^4)$ memory as windows or token grids grow. Furthermore, Swin adds a learned relative-position bias elementwise to attention scores, requiring full materialization of the score matrix and its gradient. This keeps Swin and SwinV2 trapped in a small-window($M=8,16$), coarse-token regime with patch size $4\times4$ ($p=4$), limiting performance for fine-grained tasks. We introduce FLASHSWIN, which replaces standard windowed attention with a FlashAttention implementation that computes exact softmax attention without materializing the score matrix, reducing per-window memory from $O(M^4)$ to $O(M^2)$. This enables higher token density and larger receptive fields without inflating memory overhead. Training memory is flat across window sizes: at a $32\times32$ window, FLASHSWIN-T requires only $12.4$\,GB, unchanged from $8\times8$, compared to $70/90$\,GB for SwinV2/V1-T. However, applying FlashAttention directly to Swin creates a trade-off: bypassing the score matrix precludes Swin's additive relative-position bias, forfeiting spatial information in exchange for memory efficiency. FLASHSWIN restores position information as window-local learnable 2D RoPE, making large windows and dense token grids both affordable and accurate. At matched scale, FLASHSWIN-T outperforms Swin variants. With dense tokens and wide windows ($p=2,M=32$), the same Tiny model reaches $84.1\%$ ImageNet-1K, $44.1$ COCO box AP, and $47.28$ ADE20K mIoU---gains of $+1.3$, $+5.1$, and $+1.82$ over SwinV2-T at $M=16$, respectively. At fixed $M=32$, halving the patch size yields roughly $3\times$ larger gains in boundary quality than in mIoU.

AI.tldr: FLASHSWIN用FlashAttention替换Swin的窗口注意力，将每窗口内存从O(M^4)降至O(M^2)，并以窗口局部可学习2D RoPE补偿位置信息，从而实现大窗口、密集token的高分辨率视觉骨干。
AI.motivation: 高分辨率视觉骨干长期需要在局部token密度与感受野之间权衡。Swin类层级Transformer的窗口注意力需逐窗口实例化M^2×M^2的注意力得分矩阵，内存随窗口或token网格增大呈O(M^4)，且相对位置偏置需对得分矩阵及其梯度完整实例化，导致Swin/SwinV2被迫停留在小窗口(M=8,16)、粗token（patch=4×4）的范式，限制细粒度任务性能。
AI.method: 1) 用FlashAttention实现精确softmax窗口注意力，不实例化得分矩阵，将每窗口内存由O(M^4)降到O(M^2)，实现训练内存对窗口大小基本恒定。2) 针对绕过得分矩阵后无法使用Swin加性相对位置偏置的问题，改用窗口局部可学习的2D RoPE恢复位置信息，使大窗口与密集token网格兼具可负担性与精度。
AI.result: 在32×32窗口下，FLASHSWIN-T仅需12.4GB内存，与8×8窗口持平，而SwinV2/V1-T需70/90GB。同等规模下FLASHSWIN-T优于Swin系列。采用密集token与宽窗口(p=2, M=32)时，同一Tiny模型达到ImageNet-1K 84.1%、COCO box AP 44.1、ADE20K mIoU 47.28，相较M=16的SwinV2-T分别提升+1.3、+5.1、+1.82。在固定M=32时，patch减半带来的边界质量增益约为mIoU增益的3倍。
AI.conclusion: 以FlashAttention替代标准窗口注意力并配合窗口局部2D RoPE，可同时解除Swin在窗口大小和token密度上的内存束缚，使高分辨率细粒度任务在保持高效的同时获得显著精度与边界质量提升。

title: Extracting Persona Subspaces Through Iterative Nullspace Projection For Modulation
summary: Large Language Models (LLMs) can adopt distinct personas to tune their semantics, expertise, and perspective to different users and tasks. Precise control over these traits is critical to ensure safety and reliability in model behavior. Existing methods like activation steering and prompt-based persona induction reduce a persona to a single dominant direction, missing the finer, nested traits that emerge only once that dominant signal is factored out. We introduce modulation as a setting where the persona context is already embedded in the content being manipulated, requiring control methods to amplify or suppress a trait already present rather than inject it from scratch. PaSS is an inference-time control paradigm that models personas as multi-dimensional subspaces in a model's latent space without supervised contrastive examples. The persona subspaces are extracted via iterative concept erasure and applied to modulate persona-guided generation without retraining. To extract this subspace, we use Iterative Nullspace Projections (INLP) to linearly and iteratively isolate persona-specific directions. We causally evaluate six personas against diverse tasks like MATH-500, TinyAlpaca, GSM8K, and IFEval, showing that discriminative, iterative subspace extraction captures diverse traits underlying a given persona, enabling stronger and larger modulation than single-direction additive methods, while maintaining content fidelity. We further study individual peeled directions within each subspace to uncover the distinct aspects of persona behavior they encode. Overall, we show that persona subspaces offer a controllable, interpretable, and generalizable framework for modulating LLM behavior without sacrificing task performance.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 PaSS 推理时控制范式，将人格建模为潜空间的多维子空间，通过迭代零空间投影（INLP）提取人格方向，实现对已存在人格特质的放大或抑制（modulation），在保持内容保真度的同时优于单方向加性方法。
AI.motivation: 现有激活引导（activation steering）与提示式人格诱导方法将人格简化为单一主导方向，忽略了只有在剥离主导信号后才显现的更细粒度、嵌套式特质，难以对 LLM 人格进行精细控制，影响模型行为的安全性与可靠性。
AI.method: 提出 modulation 设定，即人格上下文已嵌入待操控内容中，控制方法需放大或抑制已有特质而非从零注入。PaSS 作为推理时控制范式，无需监督对比样本，使用迭代零空间投影（INLP）线性、迭代地隔离人格特定方向，将人格建模为潜空间中的多维子空间，并应用于人格引导生成而无需重训练。
AI.result: 在 MATH-500、TinyAlpaca、GSM8K、IFEval 等多样任务上因果评估六种人格，表明判别式、迭代式子空间提取能捕获人格背后的多样特质，实现比单方向加性方法更强、幅度更大的调制，同时保持内容保真度；并进一步分析子空间内各剥离方向，揭示其编码的人格行为不同侧面。
AI.conclusion: 人格子空间为调制 LLM 行为提供了可控、可解释且可泛化的框架，且不牺牲任务性能。

title: COMPASS: Comet Object Measurement Pipeline with Automated Selection and Scoring
summary: Summary: The single-cell gel electrophoresis ('comet') assay is a widely used technique for quantifying DNA damage at the individual cell level. However, image analysis often relies on manual inspection or semi-automated software, which can be labor-intensive, difficult to reproduce, and sensitive to image quality and comet morphology. COMPASS automates comet assay image analysis by combining deep learning-based comet segmentation with damage measurement and automated comet selection. The pipeline produces standardized DNA damage measurements while offering robust detection, reducing manual effort and improving reproducibility through transparent selection and optional manual review. Availability and implementation: COMPASS is implemented in Python and is freely available at https://github.com/ rsinghlab/COMPASS. Installation instructions, pretrained weights, and example usage are provided in the repository. Contact: jack_roberts2@brown.edu, ritsingh@illinois.edu Supplementary information: Available onlime upon publication.

AI.tldr: COMPASS 是一个开源 Python 工具，将深度学习彗星分割与损伤测量、自动彗星筛选结合，实现单细胞凝胶电泳（彗星实验）图像分析的自动化，提升可重复性并减少人工工作量。
AI.motivation: 彗星实验广泛用于单细胞水平的 DNA 损伤定量，但现有图像分析多依赖人工判读或半自动软件，劳动强度大、可重复性差，且对图像质量和彗星形态敏感。
AI.method: COMPASS 将基于深度学习的彗星分割与 DNA 损伤测量、自动化彗星筛选相整合，形成标准化分析流程，并提供透明的筛选机制及可选的人工复核。
AI.result: 该流程可输出标准化的 DNA 损伤测量结果，并具备稳健的检测能力；通过自动化与透明筛选降低人工投入，提高分析可重复性。
AI.conclusion: COMPASS 以 Python 实现并开源（https://github.com/rsinghlab/COMPASS），提供安装说明、预训练权重与示例用法，可作为彗星实验图像分析的自动化解决方案。

title: Steering Speech-Language Models: Training-Free Task Specialization via Contrastive Activation Addition
summary: Activation steering has proven effective for controlling the behavior of Large Language Models (LLMs) at inference time, but its application to SpeechLLMs remains new, and training-free steering approaches for such models are still largely unexplored. We propose a training-free Contrastive Activation Addition (CAA) protocol that derives steering vectors for common speech tasks (e.g. transcription) in SpeechLLMs from a small number of labeled utterances. We showcase that adding these vectors in the representation space, at inference time, enforces better the targeted speech task. We further show that, when combined with prompting, these vectors yield to consistent improvement over prompting alone on most evaluated tasks such as Automatic Speech Recognition (ASR) or Emotion Recognition (ER), and transfer to out-of-domain data. We additionally demonstrate the usefulness of script-normalization directions to enforce the target script of a specific language.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种免训练的对比激活加法（CAA）协议，为 SpeechLLM 推导语音任务导向的激活引导向量，在推理时增强目标任务表现。
AI.motivation: 激活引导在 LLM 推理时行为控制上有效，但其在 SpeechLLM 上的应用尚属新兴，且针对此类模型的免训练引导方法仍基本未被探索。
AI.method: 提出免训练 CAA 协议：从少量带标注语音样本中，为常见语音任务（如转写）推导引导向量，并在推理时将其加至表示空间；可与提示（prompting）结合使用；同时引入脚本归一化方向以约束特定语言的书写系统。
AI.result: 在多数评估任务（如 ASR、情感识别 ER）上，向量与提示结合较单独提示取得一致提升，并可迁移至域外数据；脚本归一化方向被证明能有效强制特定语言的脚本。
AI.conclusion: CAA 是一种适用于 SpeechLLM 的免训练、任务导向的激活引导方法，能增强目标任务控制、与提示互补，并具备域外泛化与脚本控制能力。

title: When Debate Helps: Proposal Supply and Verification-Aware Readout in Multi-Agent Reasoning
summary: Multi-agent debate can improve reasoning, yet often fails to beat simple majority voting. We argue that successful debate requires two distinct mechanisms: proposal supply must surface a correct answer, and readout must identify that answer when voting misses it. We formalize the first requirement through recoverable headroom, which measures cases where a correct proposal is available but the majority answer is wrong. For the second, we develop Latent Verification Debate (LVD), an accounting model in which candidate proposals receive answer-specific verification evidence before final generation. Controlled fixed-proposal interventions estimate this latent effect in equivalent peer-support units and show that correct evidence changes answer probabilities and generated decisions while proposal supply remains fixed. To improve proposal supply, we construct societies from neural-thicket agents using labeled and label-free coverage objectives. Across two backbones and matched-budget reasoning benchmarks, coverage-selected societies increase complementary proposal supply and improve aggregate accuracy in repeated stochastic evaluations. Round-level controls further show that interaction provides gains beyond applying the same finalizer directly to the initial proposals. These results identify proposal coverage and truth-sensitive evidence use as complementary conditions for debate to outperform voting. Code is available at https://github.com/Wang-ML-Lab/when-debate-helps.

AI.tldr: 该论文指出多智能体辩论常难以胜过多数投票，其成功依赖两个互补机制：提案供给需浮现正确答案，读取机制需在投票遗漏时识别它。作者用"可恢复余量"刻画前者，提出潜变量验证辩论（LVD）建模后者，并通过覆盖度目标构建社会智能体，实验证明二者是辩论超越投票的互补条件。
AI.motivation: 多智能体辩论被寄予提升推理能力的期望，但实证中往往无法击败简单的多数投票。作者认为这种失败源于未被区分开来的两个必要条件：正确提案是否被供给出来，以及读取机制能否在多数投票出错时识别正确提案。
AI.method: 1）形式化"可恢复余量"，度量存在正确提案但多数答案错误的案例；2）提出潜变量验证辩论（LVD），一种候选提案在最终生成前获得答案特定验证证据的核算模型，用受控固定提案干预在等价同伴支持单位上估计该潜变量效应；3）为改善提案供给，基于神经丛（neural-thicket）智能体，利用有标签与无标签覆盖度目标构建社会。
AI.result: 在两种骨干模型和匹配预算的推理基准上，覆盖度筛选的社会提升了互补提案供给并改善了重复随机评估下的聚合准确率；受控固定提案干预显示正确证据改变答案概率与生成决策而提案供给保持不变；轮级控制表明交互带来的增益超过将同一终结器直接应用于初始提案。
AI.conclusion: 提案覆盖度与对真值敏感的证据使用是辩论超越投票的两个互补条件；二者缺一不可，需同时优化。代码已开源。

title: Understanding Errors in LLM-Based Question Answering over Imperfect Tables
summary: Answering questions over imperfect tables requires handling errors that can affect the answer. We investigate two challenges for large language models (LLMs): whether error discovery depends on where errors appear in a table, and whether providing their locations is sufficient for accurate question answering (QA). Using human-reviewed instances from RADAR-T, we conduct controlled studies across three LLMs by varying row order and comparing original, error-marked, and repaired tables. First, reordering rows changes error discovery even when the table contents and gold answer remain unchanged. During direct inspection, LLMs are more likely to discover all rows containing relevant errors when these rows appear later in the table or are grouped more closely together. Second, providing verified error locations alone is insufficient for accurate QA: with code execution, accuracy on repaired tables exceeds that on error-marked tables by 39.0-59.1 percentage points across the three LLMs. As a practical application of these findings, we combine error discovery across shuffled table views with explicit guidance for verifying and handling the reported errors in a simple workflow, Geometry-Balanced Discovery and Intervention (GBDI). On RADAR-T, GBDI improves QA accuracy by 3.8-18.5 percentage points over a code-agent baseline across five LLMs (paired 95% confidence intervals exclude zero for four), at the cost of additional inference. These results highlight the importance of both reliable error discovery and effective error handling in QA over imperfect tables. Code is available at https://github.com/645-t/GBDI-ICLR-2027.

AI.tldr: 该论文研究大语言模型在不完美表格问答中的错误发现问题与错误处理问题，并提出GBDI工作流提升问答准确率。
AI.motivation: 表格中存在的错误会影响问答结果，因此需要探究LLM的错误发现是否受错误在表格中位置的影响，以及仅提供错误位置是否足以支撑准确的表格问答。
AI.method: 基于RADAR-T中经人工审核的实例，在三种LLM上进行受控实验：改变行顺序，并比较原始表格、标注错误表格和修复表格。据此提出几何均衡发现与干预（GBDI）工作流，将多种打乱表格视图下的错误发现与对已报告错误的显式验证和处理指引相结合。
AI.result: 即使表格内容与标准答案不变，重排行顺序也会改变错误发现；相关错误行位于表格较后位置或更集中成组时，LLM更易发现全部相关错误行。仅提供已验证的错误位置不足以实现准确问答：在代码执行条件下，修复表格上的准确率比标注错误表格高39.0–59.1个百分点。GBDI在RADAR-T上较代码智能体基线在五种LLM上提升问答准确率3.8–18.5个百分点（四种模型的配对95%置信区间不包含零），代价是额外推理开销。
AI.conclusion: 在不完美表格问答中，可靠的错误发现与有效的错误处理都至关重要，GBDI通过结合二者实现了稳定的准确率提升。

title: SepRQ : Self-Supervised Speech Mixture Representation Learning via Mask-Free, Multi-Scale Source Separation
summary: Self-supervised learning (SSL) is standard for speech representation learning, but mainstream models are designed around single-speaker audio, limiting their usefulness in multi-speakers scenarios. We present SepRQ, an open-source SSL framework that replaces masked prediction with a pseudo-source-separation objective over frozen random-projection codebooks. By adopting a novel mask-free, multiresolution approach, SepRQ achieves state-of-the-art performance in Speaker Diarization and Speech Separation on the SUPERB benchmark, surpassing WavLM and other cocktail-party derived SSLs at both Base and Large scales, while requiring only 85.68M inference parameters. SepRQ also demonstrates strong performance across target-speaker tasks requiring enrollment (such as Target-Speaker Automatic Speech Recognition), and on the challenging multi-domain DIHARD 3 diarization dataset. Notably, we report strong separation capabilities on three-speaker mixtures (WSJ0-3Mix), where current SSL literature struggles. While cocktail-party SSLs remain scarce and closed-source, limited to C-HuBERT and the enrollment-based SA-WavLM, we open-source SepRQ to the community.

AI.tldr: SepRQ：开源自监督语音表征框架，用伪源分离目标替代掩码预测，实现多说话人场景SOTA。
AI.motivation: 主流自监督语音模型面向单说话人音频设计，在多说话人（鸡尾酒会）场景下适用性受限；且现有鸡尾酒会SSL稀缺、闭源，仅有C-HuBERT与基于注册的SA-WavLM。
AI.method: 提出SepRQ开源SSL框架，以冻结随机投影码本上的伪源分离目标替代掩码预测；采用无掩码、多分辨率（multiresolution）的新方法。
AI.result: 在SUPERB的说话人日志与语音分离任务上达到SOTA，Base与Large规模均超越WavLM及其他鸡尾酒会衍生SSL，推理参数量仅85.68M；在需注册的目标说话人任务（如TS-ASR）及DIHARD 3日志数据集表现强劲；在WSJ0-3Mix三说话人混合分离上展现强能力。
AI.conclusion: SepRQ以无掩码伪源分离范式在多说话人SSL任务上取得领先，兼顾参数效率与开源，填补鸡尾酒会SSL稀缺、闭源的空白。

title: Penumbra: Sample-Efficient Adversarial Search for Regulatory Obligations
comment: Accepted at the Workshop on Self-Evolving Diversity-Driven Search for Robust AI Systems (EvoRobust) at NeurIPS 2026. Workshop papers are non-archival. 12 pages (4 content pages plus references and appendices)
summary: Agents are entering finance, healthcare and law, sectors where a violation leaves no lexical signature and carries real penalties. Whether an omission is material, or a disclosure sufficient, depends on what the response left out. Probing such an obligation means finding responses one minimal edit from flipping compliance, and every probe costs a generation and two adjudications, so the binding constraint on regulatory red-teaming is sample efficiency, not volume. We introduce Penumbra, an adversarial search that walks from a verified anchor under an expanding edit budget until a two-evaluator committee changes its verdict, and emits the two adjacent responses that straddle the change. Allocation is adaptive, and the objective is coverage of the defeat surface: distinct (obligation x defeat mode) cells resolved per candidate. At matched budget, adaptive allocation reaches uniform allocation's full-budget coverage on 59% of the candidates; at equal records it covers 1.43x the defeat modes of naive enumeration, and the gain is confined to the axis it targets. On 60 screened obligations of a financial advisory constitution, Penumbra returns 144 pairs, each a compliant and a violating response that the committee places on opposite sides of the boundary, differing by a handful of words where a model asked for both directly produces texts sharing almost nothing. A second constitution, for clinical triage, reproduces this on 18 obligations: 49 pairs at the same tightness, with the same modes hardest. Pairs like these show where an obligation's own terms stop deciding, which is what an agent deployed under it must be tested against, and the search finds them at a cost that scales with the boundary, not the text.

AI.tldr: Penumbra：面向合规边界的对抗式搜索，通过自适应编辑预算沿"失败面"定位最小编辑对，仅需少量生成与裁定即可产出紧贴边界的合规/违规对照文本。
AI.motivation: 代理进入金融、医疗、法律等有实际处罚的领域，但违规常无表层词法特征，是否"遗漏重要信息"或"披露充分"取决于响应所省略的内容。探测此类义务需要找到距违规仅一步之遥的响应，而每次探测都耗费一次生成与两次裁定，故监管红队的瓶颈是样本效率而非规模。
AI.method: 提出 Penumbra 对抗式搜索：从已验证的锚点出发，在扩张的编辑预算下行走，直至双评审委员会改变裁定；输出跨越判决变化的两条相邻响应。采用自适应分配，目标为"失败面"覆盖，即以每候选解中（义务×失败模式）的独立单元计量。
AI.result: 同预算下，自适应分配在59%的候选上达到均匀分配全额预算的覆盖率；同记录数下其覆盖的失败模式为朴素枚举的1.43倍，且增益仅局限于其针对的维度。在金融顾问章程的60条义务上返回144对（合规/违规各一、委员会置于边界两侧），仅差数词，而直接要求模型同时产出两类文本则几乎无重叠。临床分诊章程在18条义务上复现：49对、同等紧致度、最难模式一致。
AI.conclusion: 此类成对样本揭示了义务条款自身用语停止决定的位置，是部署其下的代理必须被测试的对象；该搜索以与边界而非文本长度成正比的成本找到它们。

title: Not Self-Decidable: LLMs Cannot Draw the Boundary of What an Agent Verifier Can Check
comment: Accepted at the Who Verifies the Agents? Workshop at NeurIPS 2026. Workshop papers are non-archival. 21 pages (9 content pages plus references and appendices)
summary: A verifier for an agent faces rules of two kinds: the ones a fixed check can settle and the ones that require a judge. A team that derives its own checks fixes that split up front. Where the requirements come from outside, as in finance, healthcare and law, the agent enforces rules it did not write, so the split falls to runtime, recurring for every predicate of every rule on every action at a rate no reviewer can audit. Every escalation scheme assumes a model can make that decision itself, that it is self-decidable. Across six corpora, including the EU AI Act, FINRA guidance and a deployed credit agent, we collect roughly 22,000 labels from four models built by three labs. They agree almost perfectly where the answer is obvious and collapse on regulatory text; their errors run in opposite directions, so no model can be trusted as the conservative choice; and on the deployed agent's own rule-set they err together, over-claiming that a fixed check will do, the direction that never gets escalated. We introduce CoVer (corroborate-then-verify), which treats unanimity as a nomination, admitting a predicate only when the check synthesized for it survives intervention, reading fields the agent cannot write and holding under deterministic rewording. That gate rejects most of what corroboration wrongly admits, at a cost in coverage we report rather than tune away. The obvious alternative, agreement with a reference judge, certifies nothing: it climbs from 30% to 77% across calibration bands while the genuinely decidable share does not move, because a judge drawn from the population under indictment ratifies the blind spot it shares. Self-decidability is not a capability to elicit from a model but a boundary the verifier must construct.

AI.tldr: 论文指出"哪些规则可由固定检查裁定、哪些需要裁判模型"这一划分无法由模型自行判定（self-decidability 不成立），并提出 CoVer：把模型间一致视为"提名"，再通过干预、只读不可写字段与确定性改写进行验证，从而构造出可判定性边界。
AI.motivation: 当需求来自外部（金融、医疗、法律）时，agent 执行的是自己未编写的规则，检查/裁判的划分只能在运行时逐条、逐谓词、逐动作重复进行，规模远超人工审计能力。已有的升级（escalation）方案都默认模型能自行做这个判断，即假定"自可判定性"，本文要检验并反驳这一假设。
AI.method: 构建约 22,000 条标签的评测集，覆盖六个语料（含 EU AI Act、FINRA 指引与一个已部署的信贷 agent），标签来自三个实验室的四个模型。在此基线上提出 CoVer（corroborate-then-verify）：把模型间一致当作"提名"而非结论，仅当为该谓词合成的检查通过干预检验、读取 agent 无法写入的字段、并在确定性改写下保持稳定时才接纳该谓词。同时对比"与参考裁判模型一致"这一替代方案。
AI.result: 模型在答案显然时近乎完全一致，但在监管文本上集体失效；错误方向相反，故不存在可作为保守选择的模型；在已部署 agent 自身的规则集上，模型错误方向一致——都过度声称"固定检查即可"，而这恰是从不会被升级的方向。CoVer 的门控能剔除大部分被"一致性"错误接纳的谓词，代价是覆盖率下降（论文如实报告而非调参掩盖）。作为替代方案的"与参考裁判一致"不具认证力：随校准分带从 30% 升到 77%，而真正可判定的比例不变，因为裁判来自被质疑的同一人群，会认可其共享的盲区。
AI.conclusion: 自可判定性不是可以从模型身上"引出"的能力，而是验证器必须主动构造的边界。一致性应被当作候选提名，须经干预与鲁棒性检验后才能升级为可判定的固定检查；依赖同源裁判的一致性并不能提供认证。

title: Decouple, Purify and Unite: Semantic-Structural Prototype Learning for Federated Medical Segmentation
summary: Federated learning enables medical institutions to train a global model without sharing data, yet feature heterogeneity from diverse scanners or protocols remains challenging. Existing representation-based methods face two limitations: 1) Incomplete Contextual Representation Learning: single-layer or coupled representations overlook multi-level structural cues and entangle regional semantics with boundary details. 2) Layerwise Style and Aggregation Biases: domain-specific style discrepancies across intermediate layers degrade prototypes, while aggregation that overlooks client distribution shifts can further amplify bias. We propose FedBCS+, federated decoupled contextual alignment with style-purified aggregation. We employ Frequency-domain Style Recalibration (FSR) in prototype construction to decouple content-style representations and extract style-purified prototypes. Built upon these purified features, Decoupled Contextual Prototype Alignment (DCPA) explicitly decouples multi-level features into semantic and structural prototypes and aligns regional semantics and fine-grained anatomical structures separately. Style-purified Semantic Prototype Aggregation (S2PA) measures each client's purified prototype divergence from the global consensus and adaptively reweights aggregation toward under-represented clients to reduce consensus bias. On five heterogeneous medical segmentation benchmarks spanning histopathology, MRI, ultrasound, and colonoscopy, FedBCS+ achieves the highest mean Dice among the compared methods. A convergence analysis further characterizes how aggregation and alignment affect the optimization bound.

AI.tldr: 提出FedBCS+联邦学习方法，通过频域风格重校准、解耦上下文原型对齐及风格纯化语义原型聚合，解决医学图像分割中的特征异质性问题，在五个基准上取得最高平均Dice。
AI.motivation: 联邦学习可在不共享数据的前提下训练全局模型，但来自不同扫描仪或协议的特征异质性仍是挑战。现有基于表征的方法存在两个局限：1）不完整的上下文表征学习，单层或耦合表征忽略多级结构线索，并将区域语义与边界细节纠缠；2）逐层风格与聚合偏差，中间层的域特定风格差异会损害原型，而忽略客户端分布偏移的聚合会进一步放大偏差。
AI.method: 提出FedBCS+（联邦解耦上下文对齐与风格纯化聚合）。具体包括：在原型构建中采用频域风格重校准（FSR）解耦内容-风格表征并提取风格纯化原型；在此基础上，解耦上下文原型对齐（DCPA）将多级特征显式解耦为语义原型与结构原型，分别对齐区域语义与细粒度解剖结构；风格纯化语义原型聚合（S2PA）度量各客户端纯化原型与全局共识的偏差，并自适应地将聚合权重重新分配给代表性不足的客户端以降低共识偏差。
AI.result: 在涵盖组织病理学、MRI、超声和结肠镜的五个异质医学分割基准上，FedBCS+在所比较方法中取得最高平均Dice。收敛性分析进一步刻画了聚合与对齐如何影响优化界。
AI.conclusion: FedBCS+通过风格纯化与解耦上下文对齐有效缓解医学联邦学习中的特征异质性，兼顾语义与结构信息并降低聚合偏差，性能优越且具备理论收敛保障。

title: Learning Discriminative Geometry for Drifting Models
summary: Recently proposed Drifting Models shift iterative distribution refinement from inference to training, enabling effective one-step generation. However, their performance on complex image datasets depends strongly on the representation used to construct the drifting field: pixel-space drifting performs poorly, whereas pretrained feature spaces substantially improve sample quality for reasons that remain unclear. We trace this gap to the discriminative geometry of the representation, which determines sample weighting in kernel density estimation (KDE) and, consequently drift. We introduce persistent representation learning, which continuously learns a more discriminative representation geometry as the generator evolves across batches. We further establish a current-step gradient equivalence between the KDE ratio loss and drift regression loss under matched conditions, connecting density-ratio-based generator optimization to empirical drifting and motivating direct control of the drifting velocity. Across multiple datasets, our method learns effective discriminative representations directly from pixels and reduces FID by approximately $82-95\%$ over the original pixel-space Drifting Models, without pretrained encoders. Adapting pretrained representations and applying velocity clipping provide further gains.

AI.tldr: 本文揭示漂移模型性能高度依赖表征的判别几何，提出持续表征学习（persistent representation learning），无需预训练编码器即可从像素学习有效判别表征，FID相比原始像素漂移模型降低约82–95%。
AI.motivation: 漂移模型（Drifting Models）将迭代分布精炼从推理移至训练，实现有效的一步生成。但其在复杂图像数据集上的性能强烈依赖构建漂移场所用的表征：像素空间漂移效果差，而预训练特征空间显著提升样本质量，具体原因尚不明确，这一性能差距亟待解释与改进。
AI.method: 作者将该差距归因于表征的判别几何——它决定了核密度估计（KDE）中的样本加权，进而影响漂移。据此提出持续表征学习（persistent representation learning），在生成器跨批次演化过程中持续学习更具判别性的表征几何。同时，在匹配条件下建立了KDE比值损失与漂移回归损失的当前步梯度等价性，将基于密度比的生成器优化与经验漂移相连接，并据此直接控制漂移速度。
AI.result: 在多个数据集上，该方法无需预训练编码器即可直接从像素学习有效的判别表征，相比原始像素空间漂移模型将FID降低约82–95%。此外，适配预训练表征并应用速度裁剪（velocity clipping）可带来进一步提升。
AI.conclusion: 表征的判别几何是漂移模型性能的关键决定因素；持续表征学习能够从像素自发获得有效判别几何，大幅缩小与预训练特征空间的差距。梯度等价性的建立为密度比优化与经验漂移提供了理论桥梁，并支持对漂移速度的直接调控。

title: AegisFlow: A Multi-Agent Agentic AI Framework for Autonomous Remediation and Self-Healing in Fragile Data Ecosystems
summary: Traditional data pipelines are notoriously brittle, often failing due to upstream schema drift, API contract changes, or website DOM modifications. Present observability tools only raise alerts but for human engineers, resulting in a high Mean Time to Repair (MTTR) and operational fatigue. In this paper we propose AegisFlow (Agentic Engine for Intelligent Self-healing and Graph-driven Operations for Workload remediation), a novel agentic framework that closes the loop between detection and resolution. AegisFlow uses a Watchdog agent to collect runtime telemetry and has a Repair agent to automatically create, test and deploy code patches based on Large Language Models (LLMs). The framework presents the non-intrusive execution model called Parallel Shadow Patching, a non-intrusive execution model based on the Monitor, Analyze, Plan, Execute, Knowledge (MAPE-K) loop to generate and verify patches in digital twin environments. Through experimental testing, we have evaluated AegisFlow across five common failure scenarios, and see 98.1 percent improvement in MTTR (from an average of 170 minutes per patch to 3.2 minutes) and a patch success rate of 92 percent . In particular, the system is successful in dealing with changes in the JSON schema (96 percent ) and punctuation drift (98 percent ), and is least successful in Shadow DOM cases (85 percent ). AegisFlow frees up about 98 percent of data engineering on-call time from firefighting and reallocates it towards innovation. The framework is deployment agnostic consisting of a system that can be deployed in a plugin fashion into an existing pipeline orchestration system with minimal uplift to the existing system.

AI.tldr: AegisFlow 是一个基于 LLM 的智能体自愈框架，通过 Watchdog 与 Repair 双智能体和并行影子补丁机制，在数字孪生环境中自动生成并验证修复补丁，将 MTTR 从 170 分钟降至 3.2 分钟，补丁成功率达 92%。
AI.motivation: 传统数据管道脆弱，常因上游模式漂移、API 契约变更或网页 DOM 修改而失败；现有可观测性工具仅向人工工程师告警，导致修复平均时间（MTTR）高、运维疲劳严重。
AI.method: 提出 AegisFlow 智能体框架，包含负责采集运行时遥测的 Watchdog 智能体与基于 LLM 自动创建、测试、部署补丁的 Repair 智能体；核心为受 MAPE-K 循环启发的非侵入式执行模型"并行影子补丁"（Parallel Shadow Patching），在数字孪生环境中生成并验证补丁，并以插件形式部署到现有管道编排系统。
AI.result: 在五类常见故障场景中评估：MTTR 改善 98.1%（从平均每补丁 170 分钟降至 3.2 分钟），补丁成功率 92%；JSON 模式变更 96%、标点漂移 98% 表现最佳，Shadow DOM 场景最低为 85%；释放约 98% 的数据工程值班时间用于创新。
AI.conclusion: AegisFlow 将检测与解决闭环，显著降低 MTTR 与运维负担，且具备部署无关性，可作为插件最小化改造地集成到现有管道编排系统中。

title: WNet: Discrete Wavelets Transform for Efficient Token Mixing
summary: In a Transformer, token mixing is the step that lets each token draw information from other tokens, and it dominates the cost of encoding long sequences. Self-attention does this mixing very well: every token weighs every other token by content, which gives strong contextual modeling. That all-pairs comparison is also why its cost grows quadratically with sequence length. We introduce WNet, a Transformer encoder that replaces self-attention with token mixing based on the discrete wavelet transform (DWT). Three attention-free mixers recombine the scales: by linear fusion, by learned gating, or by letting each token choose its scales. A hybrid adds self-attention in the last layer only. A receptive-field analysis shows that wavelet mixers built from two-tap filters, such as Haar, never relate tokens outside fixed blocks, however deep the network, even when the filters are learned. Longer filters reach the whole sequence within two layers. We pre-train every model with masked language modeling on a fixed-token subset of C4 and fine-tune on GLUE, using one controlled setup with size-matched BERT and FNet baselines and a control that cannot mix tokens. The token-gated mixer trains as fast as attention at 256 tokens and 2.7 times faster at 4,096.

AI.tldr: 论文提出 WNet，用离散小波变换（DWT）替代自注意力的 token 混合机制，构建无注意力 Transformer 编码器，并分析其感受野与效率。
AI.motivation: 自注意力虽具强上下文建模能力，但其全配对比较导致计算代价随序列长度二次增长，长序列编码成本过高。作者希望寻找一种高效且有效的替代 token 混合方式。
AI.method: 提出 WNet，以基于 DWT 的 token 混合取代自注意力。设计三种无注意力混合器：线性融合、学习门控、以及让每个 token 自行选择尺度；另设仅在最后一层加入自注意力的混合变体。并通过感受野分析研究不同长度滤波器（如两抽头 Haar 与更长滤波器）的信息传播范围。所有模型在 C4 固定 token 子集上以掩码语言建模预训练，并在 GLUE 上微调，采用与 BERT、FNet 规模匹配的基线及一个无法混合 token 的对照。
AI.result: 感受野分析表明，基于两抽头滤波器（如 Haar）的小波混合器无论在何种深度、甚至滤波器可学习时，都无法关联固定块之外的 token；更长滤波器则可在两层内覆盖整个序列。效率方面，token 门控混合器在 256 token 时训练速度与注意力相当，在 4,096 token 时快 2.7 倍。
AI.conclusion: 基于 DWT 的 token 混合可有效替代自注意力：滤波器长度决定感受野范围，较长滤波器能快速实现全局信息传播；token 门控混合器在长序列上显著提速。WNet 为高效长序列编码提供了可行方向。

title: Knossos and Ariadne: Benchmarking and Learning Complete Diagram Topology Extraction with Vision-Language Models
summary: Structural diagrams are widely used to represent complex systems and relational information across scientific, engineering, procedural, and spatial domains. Recent vision-language models (VLMs) have become increasingly capable of recognizing diagram elements and reasoning about their content, while complete diagram topology extraction remains comparatively underexplored. In this paper, we study diagram-to-graph topology extraction: extracting all diagram entities and the complete relations among them. To enable large-scale supervised training and systematic evaluation of this task, we introduce Knossos, a benchmark of 19,200 diagrams across six diverse domains, with 245,179 nodes and 439,740 edges. Its symbolic generation process provides exact alignment between rendered diagrams and annotations of complete topology, relation types, and connector geometry. To address the modeling challenge of complete topology extraction, we also present Ariadne, a structured framework that decomposes the task into node inventory extraction and source-conditioned edge prediction. Extensive experiments show that training on Knossos substantially improves complete topology extraction in smaller open-source VLMs. Ariadne further improves over one-step extraction under matched supervision, demonstrating the additional benefit of structured decomposition. It achieves the highest average Edge F1 among the evaluated methods on Knossos, while both backbone variants also improve over their unadapted counterparts on the real-world external benchmark. Code and benchmark are available at https://github.com/bangwayne/knossos_Ariadne_Public.

AI.tldr: 该论文研究“图到图拓扑提取”任务，提出大规模基准Knossos与结构化框架Ariadne，显著提升VLM完整拓扑提取能力。
AI.motivation: 现有视觉语言模型虽能识别图元素并推理内容，但完整图拓扑提取仍研究不足，且缺乏大规模监督训练与系统评测的数据支撑。
AI.method: 构建Knossos基准，覆盖6个领域、19,200张图，含245,179个节点和439,740条边，通过符号化生成实现渲染图与完整拓扑、关系类型、连接线几何的精确对齐；提出Ariadne框架，将任务分解为节点清单提取与源条件边预测。
AI.result: 实验表明，在Knossos上训练可显著提升小型开源VLM的完整拓扑提取能力；Ariadne在同等监督下优于一步式提取，在Knossos上取得最高平均Edge F1，两种骨干变体在真实外部基准上也优于未适配版本。
AI.conclusion: 结构化分解对完整图拓扑提取有效，Knossos为大规模监督训练与系统评测提供了支撑，代码与基准已公开。

title: NAMVIS: Next-Scale Autoregressive Multi-View Image Synthesis
summary: Sparse-view novel view synthesis is a central problem in 3D content creation, but diffusion-based approaches remain limited by iterative denoising, making multi-view generation expensive at inference time. We introduce NAMVIS, a diffusion-free framework that reformulates multi-view image synthesis as geometry-conditioned next-scale autoregression. Instead of generating target views through repeated denoising, NAMVIS predicts discrete visual tokens through a small number of coarse-to-fine scale steps, while sampling all tokens within each scale and across target views in parallel. To anchor this generation process to explicit camera geometry, we propose Multi-scale Projective Pose Encoding, which injects source and target camera transformations into both target-view self-attention and source-to-target cross-attention at every resolution. NAMVIS further combines global conditioning with dense geometry-aware cross-attention, enabling the model to preserve source-view appearance while maintaining target-view consistency. Across Objaverse, GSO, and OmniObject3D, NAMVIS outperforms diffusion-based baselines in PSNR, SSIM, and LPIPS, while running over 3 times faster than the evaluated diffusion baselines under the same evaluation setting. These results suggest that geometry-conditioned next-scale autoregression is a promising and efficient alternative to diffusion for sparse-view multi-view synthesis. Additional qualitative results, videos, and resources are available at https://corl-team.github.io/namvis/

AI.tldr: NAMVIS：无扩散的稀疏视角新视角合成框架，将多视图图像合成重构为几何条件化的下一尺度自回归，用少量粗到细尺度步骤并行预测离散视觉token，速度超扩散基线3倍且指标更优。
AI.motivation: 稀疏视角新视角合成是3D内容创作的核心问题，但基于扩散的方法受迭代去噪限制，多视图生成推理代价高昂。作者希望寻找一种高效替代方案。
AI.method: 提出NAMVIS无扩散框架，将多视图合成重构为几何条件化的next-scale自回归：通过少量粗到细尺度步骤预测离散视觉token，同一尺度内及跨目标视图的token并行采样。并提出Multi-scale Projective Pose Encoding，在每一分辨率下将源与目标相机变换注入目标视图自注意力和源到目标交叉注意力；结合全局条件与密集几何感知交叉注意力，保持源视图外观与目标视图一致性。
AI.result: 在Objaverse、GSO、OmniObject3D上，NAMVIS在PSNR、SSIM、LPIPS上均超越扩散基线，且在相同评测设置下运行速度比所评估的扩散基线快3倍以上。
AI.conclusion: 结果表明，几何条件化的next-scale自回归是稀疏视角多视图合成中一种有前景且高效的扩散替代方案。

title: Verb-ICL: Rethinking In-Context Learning for Structured Prediction
